tianxia.talent.pressure_points.technique.why: Rider lane C14: Touch the Point: Close a Seal (combat/ext/shi_pressure_points.py) runs Technique-Closing Point's typed rows, which lock one ability through combat/ext/ability_lockout.py.

TAL_AXES_MOUNTAIN_FELLING_AXE_BODY.label: Mountain-Felling Axe Body
TAL_AXES_MOUNTAIN_FELLING_AXE_BODY.why: Rider lane C14: 'your axe attacks against objects ... reduce Damage Thresholds by your Proficiency Bonus for that attack only' while the form lasts (combat/ext/objects.py; needs_condition = the form's state from combat/ext/axes_body_reach.py). Its 'ignore Resistance to nonmagical weapon damage' is already true: its prerequisite Hewing Intent makes the owner's axe attacks magical when the character is compiled (axes_body_reach.hewing_traits), and objects have no nonmagical-only resistance. The talent's own rows keep compiling.

tianxia.talent.chains.weighted_links.why: Rider lane C14: 'when Chain Lash pulls or pushes a target, increase the movement by 5 feet if the target is no more than one size larger than you' (combat/ext/push_lengthening.py); the talent's own rows keep compiling.

tianxia.talent.gravity.gravity_domain.why: Rider lane C14: 'Inside the Domain: ... Forced movement caused by your Gravity talents increases by 10 feet' (combat/ext/push_lengthening.py); the Domain's own rows keep compiling.

TAL_AIR_STORM_WITHOUT_DIRECTION.why: Rider lane C14: 'No Fixed Direction: When a hostile creature is pushed or pulled in the area, increase that movement by 10 feet' -- when the storm was raised with that choice (combat/ext/push_lengthening.py); the storm's own rows keep compiling.
